node.statement: Put U=I-T and X=T-I=-U. Since ||T||<1/3, U is invertible by its Neumann series and ||X^2-I||=||-2T+T^2||<=2||T||+||T||^2<7/9<1, so the registered sign power series applies. The same binomial power series gives (X^2)^(-1/2)=(U^2)^(-1/2)=U^(-1), because both sides are the convergent power-series branch equal to I at T=0.
